On Oct 15 ALTR took the domain down and switched her to a direct link. On Oct 16 she reported 'The link flagged my account again'. This problem has been open since May 7 (162 days, third domain attempt), and it puts her IG at risk again after losing her main in August. Vivek's 'Team already on it' is the only answer so far. STILL OPEN: Olivia never answered the Oct 7 OFTV editor-access problem (9 days; Olivia silent 10 days). ALTR has still never written down what happened to @sarah.h44; she now says plainly 'my ig name is Sarah Harvey', and ALTR's new link is xli.ink/sarahharvey. There is no written status on the backup IGs (71 days), though Mayson asked her for their 2FA in the group chat on Oct 10. The leak-keyword confirmation from Oct 6 is still unwritten. Other open items: chargeback (28 days), credential purge (56 days), voice clone (48 days), Snapchat scope (37 days), Phone Farm (76 days). The call produced an inspo list, not a written plan for the 69-day earnings drop. CHURN WATCH: improving. Asks are up, and a written earnings report partly answers signal #2. Billing was only 3 of 30 ALTR messages. The live risk is signal #1: Derrek has not posted in 28 days, and the 30-day mark is Oct 18. SECURITY: no credentials were posted this window. However, ALTR (Mayson) asked for backup-account 2FA in the ~19-person group, and Sarah offered her login ('Do you need my login or are you already in?'), which went unanswered. Move both to a private channel.

That is normal for her and not a risk signal, and the absence of an instant payment is not itself a negative.
